title: Zesty Irish Currant Fritters
description: Fermented, shaggy post-workout Irish fritters packed with currants, double-fried to crunchy perfection on a binchotan grill.

ingredients.name: dried currants
ingredients.notes: soaked in warm water for 15 min

instructions: In a bowl whisk the flour, baking powder, and salt together.
Add the soaked currants, oat milk, egg, lemon zest, and smoked paprika and stir until a thick batter forms.
Heat the binchotan grill and heat sunflower oil until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the grill, spacing them 4 inches apart.
Cook each fritter until bubbles form on the surface, about 3 minutes, then flip.
Continue frying until both sides are golden brown and crisp, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove the fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a sprinkle of sea salt.
